name: Pumpkin Seeds: The 51st Floor
source:
A decade ago, civilization ended with the advent of superpowers, given to humanity so that the last one standing will create a new world.

Despite the world outside being a wasteland of violence and superpowers, there are people who have found ways to live peaceful, and even comfortable lives hidden away from those actively working to become god.

But there are a lot of tricky things people need to do the achieve that level of security, especially after 3/4th of the world population has been decimated and the rest are either hunting each other or being hunted.

This is the story of one of those people.

[From [url=https://reteryisk.itch.io/pumpkin-seeds-the-51st-floor]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
十年前，文明随着超级大国的出现而结束，赋予人类最后的生存者将创造一个新世界。

尽管外面的世界是暴力和超能力的荒原，但有些人找到了和平的方法，甚至是舒适的生活，远离那些积极努力成为上帝的人。

但要达到这种安全水平，人们需要做很多棘手的事情，特别是在世界人口有3/4被消灭而其余人口要么互相猎杀要么被猎杀之后。

这是其中一个人的故事。

[来自[url=https://reteryisk.itch.io/pumpkin-seeds-the-51st-floor]Itch.io[/url]]
